subject.title: fix(diagnostics-otel): metrics and logs posted to the traces endpoint when the shared OTLP endpoint is signal-qualified

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally normalize a shared OTLP endpoint that already ends in `/v1/<signal>` for other enabled signals, with explicit per-signal endpoints as the compatibility escape hatch?
rationale: The source and upstream contract support the fix, but the change alters existing shared-endpoint fallback behavior for any user who relied on exact reuse of one signal-qualified URL across signals.

options.title: Accept shared-endpoint normalization after proof
options.body: Require this PR to correct the docs and add real behavior proof, then land it or the chosen sibling once maintainers accept the upgrade behavior change.

options.title: Preserve exact shared URL reuse
options.body: Ask for a different design such as warning or skipping mismatched shared signal paths so existing exact shared-path behavior remains the default.

options.title: Use the existing sibling as canonical
options.body: If maintainers prefer the proof-positive sibling PR, keep this PR as backup until that branch is confirmed mergeable and current.

recommendation.title: Accept shared-endpoint normalization after proof
recommendation.body: Require this PR to correct the docs and add real behavior proof, then land it or the chosen sibling once maintainers accept the upgrade behavior change.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the endpoint preservation behavior and related resolver tests is Vincent Koc's prior diagnostics-otel endpoint work.
